releases.notes:
One word, everywhere it appears.

A place in your home is now called an area — the same word Home Assistant itself uses — rather than
a zone or a room, and the 3D view of your home is now the plan. That is the wording on screen, in
the address bar, and in the names of things underneath it.

Your dashboard, floor plan and device placements carry over. A tile that named a place the old way
is renamed where it sits rather than removed.

If you bookmarked the 3D view directly, its address has changed; the link in the sidebar is
correct.

Nothing about how your home behaves changes.
